title: ESG2Risk: A Deep Learning Framework from ESG News to Stock Volatility Prediction

extraction.methodology_summary: The authors propose a deep learning framework called ESG2Risk to predict stock volatility using ESG-related financial news. The pipeline extracts ESG news using an in-house vocabulary filter, transforms raw text into dense embeddings using a pre-trained Transformer language model and extracts sentiment scores, and feeds these into stacked dense layer encoders. A Bayesian deep learning framework using stochastic gradient MCMC is employed to learn model parameters and generate robust ensemble volatility predictions over 1-week and 2-week horizons.
extraction.universe: MSCI US and All Cap EU stocks

key_findings: Transformer-based language models combined with sentiment analysis successfully extract predictive information from ESG newsflow for stock volatility.
The ESG2Risk framework significantly outperforms models using solely sentiment metrics across both MSCI US and All Cap EU markets.
Stocks with high predicted volatility exhibit significantly lower forward returns, allowing the identification of potential high risk and low return names.
Integrating ESG newsflow can positively contribute to equity portfolio performance and risk management.
